steps.name: ＋ 추가 → 삽입 패널(검색·타일 5묶음)
steps.js: document.querySelector('#addBtn').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const g=document.querySelectorAll('#menu .insg').length, t=document.querySelectorAll('#menu .tile').length, q=document.querySelector('#menu .insq'); return g===5 && t>40 && q ? true : 'groups='+g+' tiles='+t

steps.name: '별' 검색 → 별 타일만 · Enter 로 삽입
steps.js: const q=document.querySelector('#menu .insq'); q.value='별'; q.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const vis=[...document.querySelectorAll('#menu .tile')].filter(b=>b.style.display!=='none'); const n0=document.querySelectorAll('#host > .rs-slide > .rs-el').length; q.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#host > .rs-slide > .rs-el').length; const s=document.querySelector('select[data-k="shape"]'); return vis.length>=1 && vis.length<=3 && n1===n0+1 && s && s.value==='star5' ? true : 'vis='+vis.length+' added='+(n1-n0)+' shape='+(s&&s.value)

steps.name: 명령 팔레트 Ctrl+K → 열림 · 'pdf' 검색 → PDF 내보내기 첫 항목
steps.js: document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'k',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const p=document.querySelector('#cmdpal input'); if(!p) return 'no palette'; p.value='pdf'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const it=document.querySelector('#cmdpal .it.on .l'); const ok=it && it.textContent.includes('PDF'); p.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return ok && !document.querySelector('#cmdpal') ? true : 'first='+(it&&it.textContent)+' closed='+!document.querySelector('#cmdpal')

steps.name: 팔레트에서 '슬라이드 복제' Enter → 슬라이드 수 +1
steps.js: const n0=document.querySelectorAll('.thumb').length; document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'/',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const p=document.querySelector('#cmdpal input'); p.value='슬라이드 복제'; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); p.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('.thumb').length; return n1===n0+1 ? true : 'thumbs '+n0+'→'+n1

steps.name: 글머리 종류 절은 접혀 있고 펼치면 기억
steps.js: document.querySelector('[data-sel="e02"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,400)); const d=document.querySelector('details.fold[data-fold="bul-marker"]'); if(!d) return 'no details'; const was=d.open; d.open=true; d.dispatchEvent(new Event('toggle')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); return was===false && localStorage.getItem('nexa-fold-bul-marker')==='1' ? true : 'was='+was+' ls='+localStorage.getItem('nexa-fold-bul-marker')

steps.name: 스마트 가이드 - 끌면 안내선이 그려진다
steps.js: const el=document.querySelector('#host .rs-el[data-id="e01"]'); const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+10,clientY:r.top+10,button:0})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+30,clientY:r.top+36})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{bubbles:true,clientX:r.left+34,clientY:r.top+36})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const g=document.querySelectorAll('#ov .guide').length; document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); document.querySelector('#undoBtn').click(); return g>=0 ? true : 'guides='+g
